method: decisions: exact count infer_all makes (arange(12, L+1e-9, 8) trace voxels of the AFVFibers geometry, fibers > 2.5 mm); CT: union of level-2 chunks within R level-2 voxels of the fibers; on the 10 G0 fibers villa read 392 chunks, a ball of R=120 gave 415 (covers 357 of the 392), R=170 covers all 392 (750 chunks); throughput 1.35 decisions/s (1 process, 16 threads, CT cached; 1.47 with 4 crop threads; 2 processes x 6 threads gave 1.44 aggregate); bandwidth 0.55-0.62 MiB/s measured to S3 from this machine today (8 connections).
note: whole-fiber footprints are far larger than the heldout-eval repo figures (10.4 / 3.9 GiB), which covered only GT points within a reach of each seed, not whole fibers
